desc:
A 132 pattern is a triple of indices i < j < k with nums[i] < nums[k] < nums[j]. Among all 132 patterns in nums, find the largest possible value of nums[k] (the last element of the pattern) and return it. If the array contains no 132 pattern, return -1.

Example: [3, 1, 4, 2] contains the pattern (1, 4, 2) and no other, so the answer is 2. In [1, 6, 4, 5, 3, 2, 7] the best pattern is (1, 6, 5), so the answer is 5.
hints: Checking all triples is O(n3). Fix the nums[i] and ask: among the elements to its right, which values can play the '2' of a 132 pair, meaning some earlier larger element exists between i and it?

Scan from right to left. For the suffix after i let third be the largest value that has a strictly larger element somewhere to its left inside that suffix. If third > nums[i], then nums[i] works as the '1' with that value.

Maintain a stack of values, popping all values smaller than the current element and updating third = max(third, popped) (those popped values have a bigger element on their left, the current one). Before processing an element x, if x < third the value third is achievable; the answer is the largest such third.
editorial: Scanning from the right, let third be the maximum over all pairs (j, k) in the suffix with j < k and nums[k] < nums[j] of nums[k]. A pattern with first element nums[i] exists exactly when nums[i] < third, and then the best last element is third itself, because any larger candidate would already be included in the maximum. So the answer is the largest third seen at an index where nums[i] < third.

To maintain third, keep a stack of the values to the right of the current position, with the largest values nearest the bottom (the stack is non-increasing from bottom to top). When the current value x arrives, pop every stack value smaller than x: each popped value has x as a larger element on its left, so it is a valid '2' and may raise third. Then push x. Because third never decreases as the scan moves left, we simply record third whenever the current element lies below it and keep the maximum. Every value is pushed and popped once, so the time is O(n) and the space O(n).
